topic: Engineering a Unique Future: Non-Traditional Technical Career Paths in Chemical Engineering
title: Engineering a Unique Future: Non-Traditional Technical Career Paths in Chemical Engineering
session_title: Engineering a Unique Future: Non-Traditional Technical Career Paths in Chemical Engineering
abstract: What do you know about the career paths available to chemical engineering graduates? You're probably aware of plant engineering or maybe have hopes of going into R&D or process engineering. However, there is a whole world of possible careers available that new ChemE graduates may not be aware of. Is a career in project management, advanced process controls, or reliability in your future? In this session, we will dig into those lesser-known technical career paths ChemE graduates can pursue when working in industry and manufacturing.
